description: Use this when someone asks about one mining project or property by its name (Oyu Tolgoi, Kamoa-Kakula, Côté, Tropicana…): who owns it, where it is, its resources and reserves, its studies or drill results. Give it the property's name, and the company if you know it. Returns the property's owner, country and commodities; its latest resource and reserve estimate with each category's tonnes, grade and contained metal as the release printed them, its effective date and reporting code; earlier estimates; its studies and drill releases; the company's own approved sustainability statement and the ESG grades it announced, each with its source; and the 6ix.com link to each release.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

property.description: The property's name as its owner prints it
